messages:
incident-bot: P1 Alert: service=redwood-serving-prod-west symptom=GPU OOMs during prefill -> repeated container restarts on multiple pods. alerts: cuda_oom, pod_restart_rate, latency_spike. paging @oncall-ryan

oncall-ryan: acknowledging. jumping in. whats the blast radius? which model(s) and nodes?

maria: logs show CUDA OOMs tied to model=rw-gpt-13b-ctx32k-quant on gpu-node-9 and gpu-node-14. prefill allocations spike when clients send >16k token prompts. sample: "CUDA out of memory: Tried to allocate 1.5 GiB" then kube reports OOMKilled.

andrew: traffic telemetry: p95 input length jumped to ~21k tokens for a small subset (0.8% of reqs) between 02:03-02:12 UTC. Those requests were being batched into prefill; batch size became 6 which multiplied peak alloc.

sophie: immediate mitigations suggestion: 1) disable prefill batching in prod-west; 2) set a runtime hard cap max_prefill_tokens=12288 (reject > cap); 3) emergency route 50% of rw-gpt-13b-ctx32k to rw-gpt-7b-ctx16k; 4) cordon problematic nodes. Anyone can run routing/scale?

oncall-ryan: @deploy-bot apply emergency routing and scale + cordon nodes. keep a small canary (25%) on the 13B variant.

deploy-bot: change request received: chg-emergency-20261108-01. Applying routing change: 50% -> rw-gpt-7b-ctx16k, 25% canary rw-gpt-13b-ctx32k, 25% -> fallback-small. Scaling +2 nodes requested.

deploy-bot: routing change active. autoscale requested; provisioning new instances.

infra-joe: cordoning node gpu-node-9 to stop new pods from landing: kubectl cordon gpu-node-9. will drain once restarts stable.

maria: pushed a short-term runtime guard to reject prefill requests larger than 12288 tokens and switched prefill batching off in prod-west. small patch pushed to runtime hotfix branch and rolled to prod canary, then prod. patch id=hotfix/prefill-cap-20261108

maria: quick log after guard: OOM events dropped from 9 -> 0 in 10m on gpu-node-9. node gpu-node-14 still has residual restarts but decreasing.

andrew: impact snapshot: ~0.9% of requests returned 5xx in the 9m spike window; p99 latency for streaming endpoints rose 2.5x. two paying customers reported session errors, CS triage in flight.

customer-success-lina: reached out to the two flagged accounts (GammaHealth and BetaCorp). letting them know issue and mitigation steps; offering a status call if needed.

sophie: added a short-term alert: prefill_batch_size > 4 AND avg_input_tokens > 10000 -> page SRE. also lowered pod_restart threshold to 2 in 5m.

oncall-ryan: documenting commands used for change audit:
```
# emergency routing
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/routing" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"service":"redwood-serving-prod-west","rules":[{"from":"rw-gpt-13b-ctx32k","to":"rw-gpt-7b-ctx16k","percent":50},{"from":"rw-gpt-13b-ctx32k","to":"rw-gpt-13b-ctx32k","percent":25}]}'

# runtime toggles
redwoodctl runtime set --scope=prod-west --name=prefill_batching_enabled --value=false
redwoodctl runtime set --scope=prod-west --name=max_prefill_tokens --value=12288

# cordon node
kubectl cordon gpu-node-9
```

maria: root-cause hypothesis: prefill batching combined multiple very large prompts into a single GPU allocation window, causing transient peak allocations beyond what quantized 13B runtime can satisfy (memory fragmentation exacerbates it). fixes proposed: a) prefill token accounting to prevent batching oversubscription; b) streaming prefill path that pages into CPU when nearing GPU limit; c) improved allocation retry/backoff instead of hard kill.

andrew: follow-ups and owners:
- maria: full RCA + PR with permanent guard and streaming fallback (due 3 business days)
- andrew: gather GPU fragmentation and allocator metrics (device reserved vs usable) and evaluate quantization tweak (due 5 business days)
- sophie: add load test for long-token prefill to canary CI and create a chaos test for node restarts (due 7 business days)
- lina: customer outreach summary and post-incident email (due EOD)

incident-bot: incident status updated -> mitigated. monitoring for 60m. P1 active. pager resolved? not yet; leave open until stability window.

oncall-ryan: leaving a note: if we see any new OOMs after uncordon, revert routing to keep 75% on smaller model. Will follow up with postmortem in #postmortems. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for visibility. :eyes:
